definitions.explanation: A disciplinary measure in which an employee, especially a public servant, is barred from working for a set period, usually without pay. It is more serious than a reprimand and less serious than dismissal.

examples.japanese: {停職|ていしょく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: He received a suspension from duty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{停職|ていしょく}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}になった。
examples.english: The police officer was suspended for three months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{停職|ていしょく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher who was caught driving drunk was suspended from duty.

notes:
A word from news reports about disciplinary action, above all against public servants (teachers, police officers, local officials). The length is usually stated: {停職|ていしょく}{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}, {停職|ていしょく}{六|ろっ}か{月|げつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {停職|ていしょく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: a suspension (as a disciplinary penalty)
- {停職|ていしょく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be suspended
- {停職|ていしょく}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}: a three-month suspension

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧: disciplinary action in general; {停職|ていしょく} is one kind
- ⟦{免職|めんしょく}→免職：18807_menshoku⟧: dismissal — the job is lost, not paused
- ⟦{停学|ていがく}→停学：22314_teigaku⟧: suspension from school, the student's counterpart
- ⟦{定職|ていしょく}→定職：12348_teishoku⟧: a steady job — same reading, unrelated word
